recalled_knowledge.item: Atmospheric-neutrino flux shape: dPhi/dE roughly linear in E below ~100 MeV, flat to ~300 MeV, ~E^-3 above (Battistoni et al. 2005 as used by Billard et al. 2014)
recalled_knowledge.presumed_source: Billard, Strigari, Figueroa-Feliciano PRD 89 023524 (2014); Battistoni et al. Astropart. Phys. 23, 526 (2005)

recalled_knowledge.item: CEvNS differential cross-section dsigma/dE_R = (G_F^2 M/4pi) Q_w^2 (1 - M E_R/(2 E_nu^2)) F^2(E_R)
Low-energy weak mixing angle sin^2(theta_W) ~ 0.238 (only enters Q_w normalisation, irrelevant for shape)
(alpha,n) neutron-induced Xe recoil spectrum approximately exponential with ~25-60 keV scale
recalled_knowledge.presumed_source: general knowledge of few-MeV neutron elastic recoils on Xe

recalled_knowledge.item: Wilks/Chernoff: q0 ~ 1/2 delta(0) + 1/2 chi^2_1 under H0 for a one-sided signal strength
Gross-Vitells upcrossing formula P(max Z > z) ~ P(Z>z) + <N_up(z0)> exp(-(z^2-z0^2)/2)
Nyholt/Cheverud effective number of tests M_eff = 1 + (M-1)(1 - Var(lambda)/M)
Anand-Fitzpatrick-Haxton relativistic Lagrangians L1-L20 reduce to combinations of NR operators O1, O3-O15 (specific pairings not used quantitatively)
Energy resolution scales as sqrt(E) for a quanta-counting estimator

failed_or_abandoned: Nyholt/Cheverud eigenvalue M_eff (302 of 456) is uninformative for zero-inflated q0 distributions; abandoned as a method, reported for completeness
Gross-Vitells with asymptotic Z on the delta scan reproduces the asymptotic-metric toys (3.9-5.2 vs 3.7) but underestimates the calibrated trials factor (9.3) by ~2.5; kept only as a comparison
First test run with 2000 calibration toys floored local p at 2.5e-4 and gave NaN for robustness variants; superseded by the 300k-toy run
Two aborted launches: log directory missing before script created it; SyntaxError from dotted dict keyword names (fixed)
One-to-one mapping of L1-L20 to NR operators not attempted (low-confidence recall); the operator basis O1,O3-O15 x s/v was used instead
